t: Powerful, magnetic filter designed to increase the life of central heating systems and deliver maximum efficiency. Includes dirt trap for non-magnetic particles. Suitable for all central heating systems. Acts as water treatment dosing point for liquid chemicals. Bottom-mounted air bleed with fully adjustable stem for mess-free priming and allows the unit to be fully emptied. The inlet and outlet ports are in line for fast fitting into vertical pipe runs without the need for additional fittings. Zytel glass reinforced nylon body pressure rated to 10bar at 82°. Central heating water can flow from bottom to top, or top to bottom.
b: Stainless Steel Filter for Non-Magnetic Particles
